label: survival stage - not for selection

selection.note: PRE-REGISTERED (v2-select-v1): Pareto over (Train E adverse, day-clustered t, payoff asymmetry, trades/day capped, E at EXIT_SHOCK, novelty), then daily-return correlation de-dup; Train numbers only; no binary sign/volatility gate

test_fold_note: folds whose TEST side is read; fold 0 test is excluded by default (set [0,1,2,3] to include it)

neighbours.note: +-1 grid step of each numeric gene of the fixed structure (event variants excluded)

checks.note: INFORMATIONAL checks per finalist; the orchestrator decides, nothing here re-selects
